purchases.inboundCreditNotesHint: Credit notes received as e-invoices. Review each one and record it as a vendor credit (debit note).
purchases.vendorCreditFailed: Could not record the vendor credit
purchases.claimQueuedForPayroll: Claim will be reimbursed on the next payroll run
purchases.receiptLinesHint: Allocate this receipt to several expense accounts. The lines replace the receipt amount and VAT.
purchases.reviseReceiptHint: The original journal entry is reversed and the corrected one is posted. A reason is required.
purchases.splitReceiptHint: Use this when one upload holds several receipts. The parts must add up to the receipt amount.
purchases.receiptLineAmountInvalid: enter an amount greater than zero (at most 2 decimals)
purchases.receiptPartsRequired: A split needs at least two receipts
purchases.receiptPartsTotalMismatch: The parts must add up to the receipt amount
purchases.receiptReasonRequired: Enter the reason for the revision
purchases.poUpgradeDescription: Create and track purchase orders to your vendors. Manage procurement workflows and match POs to invoices.
purchases.claimApproveHint: Add optional notes and approve this expense claim.
purchases.claimRejectHint: Please provide a reason for rejecting this expense claim.
purchases.claimPayrollEmployeeHint: Choose the employee whose next payroll run reimburses this claim.
purchases.poSearch: Search by number, vendor or status
purchases.poNoMatchBody: Try a different keyword or clear the search.
purchases.poReceivedNoStock: Received, but stock was not updated
purchases.poReceivedNoStockHint: Some lines have no product, so no stock moved and nothing was posted to inventory for them. Edit the order and choose a product for stocked items.
purchases.automation.title: Automatic posting
purchases.automation.description: Receipts the system is confident about can be posted without a review.
purchases.automation.switchHint: Others wait for you in the receipts list.
purchases.automation.thresholdHint: Higher means fewer receipts post on their own.
purchases.automation.pausedBody: Fewer than {threshold}% of recent suggestions were accepted, so every receipt waits for your review.
purchases.automation.how1: Your bank and expense rules are checked first.
purchases.automation.how2: Then the supplier and words on the receipt.
purchases.automation.how3: Then how you classified similar receipts before.
purchases.automation.how4: Only a receipt above the confidence you set posts on its own.
purchases.capture.title: Supplier invoice
purchases.capture.hint: Drop the PDF or a photo of the invoice. We read it and fill in the bill. Nothing is saved until you save the bill.
purchases.capture.hintOff: Automatic reading is not enabled on this server. Attach the invoice and fill in the bill by hand.
purchases.capture.dropHint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WebP · up to 2 MB
purchases.capture.attachFailed: The bill was saved, but the file could not be attached
purchases.capture.filled: The form is filled in from the document
purchases.capture.matchName: Supplier {name} found by name. Check that it is the right one.
purchases.capture.matchNone: {name} is not on your supplier list yet. Use "New supplier" in the supplier field to add it.
purchases.capture.nothingSaved: Check each field before you save. The bill posts to the books only when it is approved.
purchases.capture.tooLarge: The file is larger than 2 MB
purchases.capture.errorOff: Automatic reading is not enabled on this server. Fill in the bill by hand; the file is kept as its attachment.
purchases.capture.errorSelfTrn: This document was issued by your own company: its seller TRN is your TRN. It is a sales invoice, not a bill.
purchases.capture.errorType: This file type is not supported. Use a PDF, JPG, PNG, WebP or GIF file.
purchases.capture.errorQuota: Your AI reading allowance for this month is used up. Fill in the bill by hand.
purchases.capture.errorFailed: The document could not be read. Fill in the bill by hand; the file is kept as its attachment.
purchases.capture.check.AMOUNTS_DO_NOT_A: Net plus VAT does not equal the total.
purchases.capture.check.AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The amounts on the document do not add up.
purchases.capture.check.MISSING_AMOUNT: No amount was found on the document.
purchases.capture.check.VAT_NOT_FIVE_PER: The VAT is not 5% of the net amount.
purchases.capture.check.VAT_RATE_UNUSUAL: The VAT rate on the document is unusual.
purchases.capture.check.LINES_DO_NOT_ADD: The lines do not add up to the total, so one line was used.
purchases.capture.check.DATE_MISSING: No date was found: check the bill date.
purchases.capture.check.DATE_FUTURE: The date is in the future: check the bill date.
purchases.capture.check.DATE_ANCIENT: The date is very old: check the bill date.
purchases.capture.check.DATE_FORMAT: The date could not be read: check the bill date.
purchases.capture.check.CURRENCY_INVALID: The currency could not be read: check it.
purchases.capture.check.TRN_INVALID: The supplier TRN on the document is not valid.
purchases.supplier.label: Supplier
purchases.supplier.search: Search suppliers by name or TRN
purchases.supplier.newDesc: Add the supplier now. You can complete the address and bank details on the Suppliers page.
purchases.supplier.name: Supplier name
purchases.lines.summaryDesc: One amount for the whole bill: the account it is for and its VAT treatment.
purchases.lines.summaryNeedsOne: Summary needs a bill with one line. Remove the extra lines first.
purchases.tabs.label: Bill status
purchases.tabs.awaitingMe: {n} waiting for your approval under your company's approval rules.
purchases.debitNote.listDesc: Debit notes for returns and credits from suppliers. Each one lowers what you owe and reverses the input VAT it carried.
purchases.debitNote.editorDesc: Record a return or a credit from a supplier. It posts when you save: A/P goes down and the input VAT is reversed the way the bill recovered it.
purchases.debitNote.numberOptional: Number (leave blank to number it automatically)
purchases.debitNote.billHint: Link the bill to follow its VAT treatment and to apply the credit to it.
purchases.debitNote.reasonRequired: Give the reason for the credit
purchases.debitNote.lineRequired: Each line needs a description and an amount above zero
purchases.debitNote.linesDesc: Each line credits the account it was billed to. A returned stock item leaves inventory at cost.
purchases.debitNote.vatHint: The VAT shown is at 5%. When the note is linked to a bill, it follows that bill: blocked, partly recovered or reverse-charge VAT is reversed the same way.
purchases.debitNote.applyNow: Apply the credit to this bill now
purchases.debitNote.stillLoading: The supplier bills and accounts are still loading. Try again in a moment.
purchases.debitNote.loadFailedBlock: Some of the data this form needs did not load. Use Try again above, then save.
purchases.debitNote.billNotInList: This bill could not be found in your bills list, so the credit cannot be applied to it. Untick the apply option to save the debit note without applying it.
purchases.debitNote.noOpenBalance: This bill has no open balance to apply the credit to. Untick the apply option to save the debit note without applying it.
purchases.debitNote.savedNotApplied: Debit note posted, but not applied to the bill. Apply it from the Supplier credits page.
purchases.debitNote.applyTitle: Apply the credit to a bill
purchases.debitNote.applyDesc: The credit settles part of an open bill of the same supplier and currency.
purchases.debitNote.noOpenBills: There is no open bill of this supplier in this currency.
purchases.debitNote.emptyBody: Record a debit note when a supplier credits you or you return goods.
purchases.claimReceipt.label: Receipt
purchases.claimReceipt.failed: The receipt could not be uploaded
purchases.debitNote.voidDesc: The posting is reversed: A/P goes back up, the input VAT it reversed is restored and returned stock comes back. This cannot be undone.
